sample_unit: older adults (NACC Uniform Data Set 3 records; Study 1)

links.outcome: Agreement between ChatGPT diagnoses and clinician diagnoses of neurocognitive disorders
links.effect: Study 1: fair agreement with clinicians (kappa = .33, chi-square(9) = 6021.96, p < .001); Study 2: no significant diagnostic agreement between ChatGPT versions and clinicians.
links.quote: Although ChatGPT 4 Omni shows potential in aligning with clinician diagnoses, its diagnostic accuracy is insufficient for clinical application without human oversight.

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic accuracy and reliability of ChatGPT models on retrospective clinical dataset records without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
